title: The Abstention Protocol: RCA for Clos Fabrics
abstract: arXiv:2608.21412v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Root cause analysis (RCA) in large datacenter networks is challenging because telemetry is noisy, partial, and asynchronous. Score-based approaches degrade under these conditions, often yielding unstable or incorrect attributions.   We present \textsc{CoreSec}, a production RCA system that replaces weighted fusion with a PAM-style abstention algebra. Telemetry agents are composed using control flags that yield deterministic decisions and explicit abstention when evidence is ambiguous. CoreSec combines this algebra with topology-aware configurations that capture failure surfaces across Clos fabrics and converge monotonically as evidence accumulates.   Deployed at hyperscale, CoreSec provides stable and explainable RCA behavior across diverse environments without retuning. Our experience shows that structured composition with abstention forms a practical foundation for automated RCA in real-world cloud networks.

translated_title: 弃权协议：Clos架构的根因分析
translated_abstract: 大规模数据中心网络中的根因分析（RCA）具有挑战性，因为遥测数据嘈杂、不完整且异步。基于评分的方法在这些条件下性能下降，常常产生不稳定或错误的归因。我们提出了CoreSec，一个生产级RCA系统，用PAM风格的弃权代数替代加权融合。遥测代理通过控制标志进行组合，这些标志在证据模糊时产生确定性决策和明确弃权。CoreSec将该代数与拓扑感知配置相结合，捕捉Clos架构中的故障面，并在证据积累时单调收敛。在超大规模部署中，CoreSec在各种环境中无需重新调整即可提供稳定且可解释的RCA行为。我们的经验表明，具有弃权的结构化组合为现实世界云网络中的自动化RCA奠定了实用基础。
tldr: 本文提出CoreSec，一种使用弃权代数替代加权融合的生产级RCA系统，在Clos架构中实现稳定、可解释的根因分析，无需重新调整即可适应多样环境。
en_tdlr: This paper presents CoreSec, a production RCA system that replaces weighted fusion with an abstention algebra, enabling stable and explainable root cause analysis in Clos fabrics without retuning across diverse environments.
